zoekwoorden: trivia questions and answers for older adults
beschrijving_html:
Remember when?

Rotary phones on the kitchen wall. Drive-in movies. Elvis on Ed Sullivan. The night the whole family gathered around the TV to watch men walk on the Moon.

Back in Our Day is a large print trivia book packed with 360 fun multiple-choice questions about the 1950s, 60s, 70s and 80s. It is made to be read out loud, played together and enjoyed with a cup of coffee.

Inside you'll find:

  • 360 questions in 12 nostalgic chapters: the Fifties, Sixties, Seventies and Eighties, TV classics, the movies, music and rock 'n' roll, sports heroes, cars, toys and candy, everyday life, space and big news, and famous faces
  • Large 16-point print that is easy on the eyes
  • Four answer choices for every question, with the answers at the end of each chapter, so nobody has to flip to the back
  • A clean, uncluttered layout

The perfect gift for the people who were there

A thoughtful Christmas, birthday or stocking stuffer gift for grandparents, parents, retirees and anyone who grew up with black-and-white TV and penny candy. Great for family game nights, road trips and visits with the grandkids.

Scroll up and bring back the good old days.
